head.b:comment: Indigen World Updates - a custom Blogger theme. Palette, typeface and motifs follow packages/design-tokens in the indigen-world monorepo. Colours, fonts and widths can be changed without editing this file via Blogger, Theme, Customise.
The page's own name comes first so it survives truncation in search results; the homepage gets a descriptive tail instead of the bare blog title.
Home-screen icon. Blogger serves the icon set in Settings, Favicon at /favicon.ico; this adds the 180x180 PNG iOS and Android ask for.

Description. all-head-content already emits og:description and a description meta whenever the page has a search description of its own, so this only fills the gap - the homepage, label and archive views - and never duplicates a tag Blogger has already written. og:url and og:title are Blogger's too; do not repeat them here or scrapers see two of each.

div.b:comment: Below the nav breakpoint this collapses behind the menu button. It carries inert/aria-hidden while collapsed so its links are not reachable by keyboard or screen reader; the script clears both on open and restores them on close.

b:includable.b:comment: Blogger adds Profile and Report Abuse to every new blog whether or not a theme asks for them. Declaring both here keeps them in the sidebar, styled, in place of being appended raw to the bottom of the reading column. This one is hidden by default - a product-updates blog does not need a personal Blogger profile card. Turn it on in Layout if you want one.
Blogger's abuse link. The URL is the fixed one Blogger uses, so this never depends on a data reference that could change under it.
